items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Orchard Cabaret? No. With Papa Celeste and Big(Archie?) [INTERVIEWEE] Orchard, Orchard Archie, Archie's Cabaret.

ctx.x: I told him Tom's Road House, see? He said, well, why did you leave? I say, for fighting. And he said, bring me four pieces to the, I forget the name of it, the place, ....
Orchard Cabaret? No. With Papa Celeste and Big(Archie?)
